description: On a standalone workspace that already has an Actor, `actors register tomas … --actor tomas` fails with `UNKNOWN_ACTOR: Unknown Actor: tomas`. Nothing says the author must be an existing Actor (only the first Actor may register itself).
expected: 'The author (--actor) must be a registered Actor; register tomas with --actor ci-bot'.
suggested_fix: Special-case actor.register when the author is the Actor being registered and others exist; mention the bootstrap rule in help.

description: Starting `pardner serve` while 8004 is taken returns a raw `EADDRINUSE: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use 127.0.0.1:8004` after printing 'initialized' banner lines.
expected: `PORT_IN_USE: 127.0.0.1:8004 is in use; pass --http-port or set PARDNER_HTTP_PORT`, before any 'ready' banner.
suggested_fix: Map EADDRINUSE to a PORT_IN_USE error with the override flag.

description: On the standalone service page the inline code `pardner open.` renders visibly smaller than the surrounding sentence and includes the full stop in the code style.
expected: Inline code at a matching optical size; punctuation outside the code span.
actual: Small mono text with the period inside.
suggested_fix: Set code font-size to ~0.95em with matching line-height; move the period outside <code>.
